description: Defines SafePyObject, SafePyObjectT, and SafePyHandle structs for managing Python objects in a multi-interpreter safe manner within the c10 namespace.

classes.name: SafePyObject
classes.description: A safe owning holder for a PyObject, multi-interpreter safe, with reference counting management.

classes.name: SafePyObjectT
classes.description: A type-safe wrapper around SafePyObject for specific Python object types.

classes.name: SafePyHandle
classes.description: A non-owning reference to a PyObject, suitable for global or leaked objects.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns the raw PyObject* pointer, given a specific interpreter context.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Stops tracking the current object and returns the PyObject*.
